summary: James Abromitis, 58, of Colorado, died of a flush drowning while on a commercial raft on the Slaughterhouse section of the Roaring Fork River near Aspen
location: Roaring Fork River, Slaughterhouse section (near Aspen)
notes: KVNF newscast headline; incident documented in the American Whitewater accident summary for Jan-Jun 2016. Responding agency unnamed in the KVNF headline.
